text: TEXT values escape backslash, comma, semicolon and newline on write and unescape on read.
VEVENT properties (recurrence, participants, alarms, location, timezone, duration) round-trip losslessly to and from JSCalendar.
iTIP messages use the event's uid (with SEQUENCE) as the cross-system correlation key, not the server-assigned JMAP id.
A REQUEST invitation carries the event's UID, SEQUENCE, ORGANIZER, and ATTENDEE lines.
A REPLY carries the ORGANIZER being answered and the replying ATTENDEE with its PARTSTAT.
A CANCEL carries STATUS:CANCELLED with the event's UID and SEQUENCE.
The iMIP body part is text/calendar with a method parameter matching the iCalendar METHOD.
A */set update response value is null unless the server changed properties beyond those the client sent.
Foo/copy reads sources from fromAccountId and supports onSuccessDestroyOriginal / destroyFromIfInState.
FilterOperator AND/OR/NOT is evaluated over nested conditions.
LocalDateTime (floating, no time zone) is accepted for date-time values.
uid is required and stable; the server auto-generates one when absent.
recurrenceRules expand honouring byDay.
bySetPosition is applied during recurrence expansion.
excludedRecurrenceRules subtract instances from the expansion.
recurrenceOverrides apply to instances; excluded:true removes an instance.
Event status is limited to confirmed/tentative/cancelled.
Task progress is limited to needs-action/in-process/completed/failed/pending/cancelled.
ParticipantIdentity isDefault is server-set; changed only via onSuccessSetIsDefault.
The scheduleStatus property represents the status of scheduling message delivery as a STATCODE string.
privacy=private: only non-owner sharees get the reduced property set; the owner sees full data.
privacy=secret: the server behaves as though the event does not exist for users other than the owner; the owner still sees it.
utcStart/utcEnd computed read-only CalendarEvent properties are returned when requested.
hideAttendees limits participant visibility to owners; it round-trips through set/get.
sendSchedulingMessages (default false): when true the server sends iTIP scheduling messages after a successful create/update/destroy.
noSupportedScheduleMethods is returned when scheduling is requested but no schedule method is available.
On create/update the origin sends a REQUEST to every current participant except the calendar owner.
With hideAttendees, each REQUEST contains only its recipient (plus the owner); other attendees are omitted.
A REQUEST to a local participant delivers the event into that participant's own calendar with participation still pending.
On destroy the origin sends a CANCEL to every participant except the calendar owner.
When not the origin, a REPLY is sent to the organizer when a user participant's participationStatus changes to a value other than needs-action.
A REPLY from a local participant is reflected into the organizer's own copy of the event.
expandRecurrences returns per-occurrence ids.
The timeZone argument (default Etc/UTC) is used to interpret before/after bounds.
canCalculateChanges is false when expandRecurrences is set (synthetic occurrence ids are not change-tracked).
minDateTime/maxDateTime/maxExpandedQueryDuration capability limits are enforced on queries.
note: Advertised in the session capability but not referenced by CalendarEvent/query or /set logic.

text: inCalendars matches events in any listed calendar.
before/after are LocalDateTime, matched against the event's start/end in the timeZone argument.
before/after accept date-only (LocalDate) values.
unknown filter conditions are rejected with unsupportedFilter (no fallthrough match).
before/after are DST-correct in a non-UTC timeZone.
sort comparators are limited to supported properties; unknown -> unsupportedSort.
sort supports start, uid, and recurrenceId.
CalendarEvent/parse converts iCalendar blobs to JSCalendar events.
CalendarEventNotification objects are server-created and can be fetched, queried, and destroyed.
